validity.value: Standard applications: photo captured on-site at the Servei de Tràmits (Processing Service) photo booth at the time of application — no prior validity window applies. Exception (children under 6, or applicants with a physical impediment preventing booth use): a photo taken within 6 months before the application must be submitted.

expression_restriction.value: Frontal position, looking directly at the camera, neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and not covered by hair.

glasses_policy.value: Glasses must be removed for the photo so the eyes are fully visible.

face_visibility.value: No hairstyle or facial ornament that partially hides the face is accepted.

headwear_policy.value: No accessory on the head is permitted.

expression.en: Frontal position, looking directly at the camera, neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and not covered by hair.
expression.ko: 정면을 보고 카메라를 직시, 무표정, 입은 다물고, 눈은 뜬 채로 머리카락에 가리지 않을 것.
expression.ja: 正面を向いてカメラを直視し、無表情、口を閉じ、目を開けて髪の毛で隠れないようにすること。

glasses.en: Glasses must be removed for the photo so the eyes are fully visible.
glasses.ko: 눈이 완전히 보이도록 촬영 시 안경을 벗어야 한다.
glasses.ja: 目がはっきり見えるよう、撮影時にはメガネを外す必要がある。

face_visibility.en: No hairstyle or facial ornament that partially hides the face is accepted.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴 일부를 가리는 헤어스타일이나 장신구는 허용되지 않는다.
face_visibility.ja: 顔の一部を隠す髪型や装飾品は認められない。

headwear.en: No accessory on the head is permitted.
headwear.ko: 머리에 어떠한 액세서리(모자 등)도 착용할 수 없다.
headwear.ja: 頭部に一切のアクセサリー(帽子等)を着用できない。
